t: The Milwaukee Hex Shank Multi-Material Drill Bit is a versatile drilling solution for trade professionals across various construction and installation tasks. This 5.5mm x 100mm drill bit is ideal for electricians fitting new sockets or plumbers installing bathroom fixtures, offering reliable performance. Its tungsten-carbide-tipped (TCT) construction ensures efficient drilling into concrete, brick, roof tiles, and aerated concrete blocks, as well as thin metal, aluminium, ceramic tiles, wood, and PVC. The impact-rated hex shank provides secure driving with impact drivers and compatibility with all 3-jaw chuck tools, including rotary and percussion drills, making it a robust choice for demanding job sites.
b: Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
